newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-LIEPAJAS METALURGS SAYS Q1 PRODUCTION UP.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-LIEPAJAS METALURGS SAYS Q1 PRODUCTION UP.

text.p: Liepajas Metalurgs, to be quoted on the bourse's free list from July 7, said on Friday its production rose in the first quorter.
The company produced 199,909 tonnes of rolled metal in the first quarter of 1997 against 90,636 in the corresponding period of 1996, a company spokesman told Reuters.
The company earlier said its 1997 target for rolled metal was 445,000 tonnes.
Metalurgs produced 6,481 tonnes of metal wire in the first quarter, an increase from 2,752 tonnes in the first three months of 1996.
The company said that its nail production was only slightly up during the first quarter at 1,673 tonnes against 1,569 tonnes.
